Targ. Deut. XXVI, 6 (O. ed. Vien. פָּלְ׳); a. fr.—Esp. priestly service, Temple service, worship.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 24:5">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 23:1">Targ. Y. Num. XXIII, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>פ׳ נוכראה</he> = h. <he>עבודה זרה</he>, idolatry.—Y. Ber. IV, beg. 7ᵃ (ref. to <he>פלח</he>.
<cite ref="Daniel 6:17">Dan. VI, 17</cite>) (in Hebr. dict.) <he>וכי יש פ׳ בבבל וכ׳</he> was there Temple service in Babylonia? But … it means prayer.
